item.description: Omni View Top World News The United States threatened to leave the International Energy Agency unless it reforms its climate focus. What You Need to Know: The United States warned it may exit the International Energy Agency over disagreements on climate priorities, while Germany committed to phasing out fossil fuels by 2045. Escalating tensions in Yemen and Ethiopia risk wider regional conflicts, and Iran’s president told the UN his country would not bend to pressure. ...
